CSES Problem Set

Apartments

  • Task
  • Statistics
  • Time limit: 2.50 s
  • Memory limit: 256 MB

There are n applicants and m free apartments.

Output

Print one integer: the number of applicants who will get an apartment.

Example

Input:

4 3 5
60 45 80 60
30 60 75

Output:

2
